input.instruction: Assess whether the reported incident is a new intake or an update. Use clarify_duplicate while event identity cannot be established. submit_claim_intake would target new_claim_draft with value {"policy_id":string,"incident_ref":"r2"}; update_claim would target r3 with value {"incident_ref":"r2"}. Do not propose either while duplicate identity remains unresolved. missing_fields may contain incident_identity for that unresolved prerequisite.
